clinical_mechanism: Calcium and iron form insoluble chelation complexes with levothyroxine in the jejunum, reducing thyroid hormone absorption by up to 75% and triggering severe fatigue, hypothermia, and TSH spikes.
mandatory_rule: Levothyroxine must be taken completely alone on waking with pure water. No calcium, iron, multivitamins, or espresso for minimum 4 hours.

clinical_mechanism: Glycyrrhizin inhibits 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2 (11-beta-HSD2), preventing renal cortisol degradation and activating mineralocorticoid receptors. This causes profound sodium retention, potassium wasting, and hypertensive crisis.
mandatory_rule: Strictly eliminate all real licorice extracts and central nervous system stimulants from daily stack.

disease_condition: Atrial Fibrillation / Deep Vein Thrombosis (Anticoagulated Patients)
clinical_mechanism: Ginkgo ginkgolides possess potent platelet-activating factor (PAF) antagonistic properties. When combined with prescription anticoagulants or antiplatelet agents, they create synergistic hemostatic impairment, exponentially increasing the risk of spontaneous subdural hematoma or gastrointestinal hemorrhage.
mandatory_rule: Limit Omega-3 to under 2000mg/day. Discontinue Ginkgo Biloba completely while on clinical anticoagulants.

clinical_mechanism: Niacin competes with uric acid for renal tubular secretion via the URAT1 organic anion transporter, decreasing urinary uric acid clearance and provoking acute, excruciating podagra (gout flare) in joint synovium.
mandatory_rule: Substitute flush-niacin with NMN or Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) if NAD+ boosting is required.

disease_condition: Chronic Kidney Disease (eGFR <60 mL/min) / Renal Insufficiency
clinical_mechanism: Impaired glomerular filtration fails to excrete potassium and magnesium efficiently. Supplemental potassium on top of ACE-inhibitor therapy precipitates life-threatening cardiac arrhythmias from hyperkalemia. Megadose Vitamin C metabolizes directly into insoluble calcium oxalate crystals in renal tubules.
mandatory_rule: Never take standalone potassium or megadose magnesium without nephrologist-reviewed serum electrolyte panels.

disease_condition: GERD / Gastritis on Chronic PPI Therapy
clinical_mechanism: Proton Pump Inhibitors elevate gastric pH above 4.5, abolishing the acid-dependent cleavage of Vitamin B12 from dietary haptocorrin and suppressing intestinal ionization of insoluble mineral carbonates.
mandatory_rule: Must transition to Calcium Citrate (acid-independent absorption) and Sublingual Methylcobalamin B12.

clinical_mechanism: Prescription stimulants inhibit DAT/NET reuptake while L-Tyrosine and L-Dopa force vesicular dopamine synthesis. Concomitant use provokes extreme central adrenergic surge, severe resting tachycardia (>120 bpm), panic states, and dangerous systolic hypertension.
mandatory_rule: Never stack dopaminergic amino acid precursors directly with prescription central stimulants.

disease_condition: Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD) / Elevated Liver Transaminases
clinical_mechanism: Fasted concentrated EGCG and mega-dose synthetic Vitamin A saturate hepatic cytochrome enzymes and stellate cells, precipitating mitochondrial oxidative stress and acute drug-induced liver injury (DILI).
mandatory_rule: Take green tea extract only with whole-food meals and cap EGCG at 300mg. Replace Vitamin A with beta-carotene.
